lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for all specific kinds of changes because each kind has only been tested once so far.
Adoption new_flow is the only kind of change proven helpful, as it produced a significant winning test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.

candidates.title: Custom Creation Guided Step Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the custom pet creation process into a step-by-step guided flow with interactive choices and visual feedback prior to certificate creation.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low 63.3% conversion rate with long completion times, and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation issues.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_creation_step']

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Companion Showcase
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring an animated showcase of desktop pet controls and interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop to see your companion. Right-click your pet for controls or drag to move.

guard.reason: Home intro redesign remains within onboarding and preserves screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users and both funnel data and support emails highlight confusion. Prior test of finish redesign yielded +1.7% lift.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Binding Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate creation so users bond with their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign in currently occurs before pet selection (72.9% conversion), creating early friction before users experience pet customization.

guard.reason: Moving sign in after adoption is explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign in step drops 27.1% of users, supported by funnel data. Previous test for sign_in reorder showed a +1.1% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Verification Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated display setup verification screen before waiting that confirms desktop display area and pet positioning permissions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app fails to launch after onboarding.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_verify']

candidates.title: Split Screen Path & Story Selector
candidates.change: Redesigns choose_path into a split layout displaying path choices alongside dynamic pet previews.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial user stalling during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Journey
choose_path.hint: Pick between quick companion adoption or full custom generation

guard.reason: The redesigned choose path still offers both adoption and custom creation.

candidates.score_note: Choose path has 23.8% drop-off and high mean time, but evidence comes only from funnel. Redesigning this step requires significant release cost.

candidates.title: Pet Identity & Character Customizer
candidates.change: Adds custom name inputs and personality trait badges directly to the adoption certificate screen to increase ownership.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest early drop-off (63.3% conversion); adding identity customization increases emotional investment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop pet a name and select its personality archetype.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Real-Time Render Progress & Audio Cue
candidates.change: Displays active rendering progress with a cheerful audio chime on the waiting screen while background assets build.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336 seconds; users need explicit visual and audio cues that pet generation is progressing.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and sound cues to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step has relatively low drop-off (18.7%). Previous wait_info change on home led to a slight negative lift (-0.3%).

candidates.title: Multi-Device Sync & Account Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear explanatory hint badge confirming that signing in protects pets across reinstallations and device logins.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again on another session.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet to your account so you never lose your pet when logging in on new devices.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' creates false urgency or scarcity

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Card Summary
candidates.change: Updates home_intro text with concise bullet points detailing right-click menu options, drag controls, and tray shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails inquiring how to hide, control, or speak to the pet right after onboarding completion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on screen to open settings, feed it, or hide it to the taskbar tray.
home_intro.hint: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on desktop.

guard.reason: Updating text in home_intro to explain controls is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off finish step supported directly by user emails. Simple copy/text update makes it low cost to deploy.

candidates.title: Welcome Mascot Voice & Sound Intro
candidates.change: Plays a friendly mascot voice greeting and animated mascot visual on the initial story screen.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion on initial path choice with a high 514s mean time points to early idle drop-offs.

guard.reason: Adding a mascot graphic and greeting audio to the story screen introduces the pet as required.

candidates.score_note: Funnel indicates idle time at choose_path, but adding sound/voice cues is risky as past hints/prompts on this step performed poorly (-2.7%).

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
new_flow changes (in adoption and home) are helpful, as both produced confirmed winning tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder have been tested twice each, showing no positive effect or worsening performance.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific kinds of changes because each has only been tested once so far.
